name: Per (Herreper)
description: The youngest, poorest brother who inherits only a cat, then follows her scheme and grows into the lordly figure called “Herreper.”
visualPrompt: A young Scandinavian peasant-turned-noble with kind, uncertain eyes; first in patched wool clothes, later in extravagant fine garments that gleam with gold trim; upright posture that shifts from hesitant to confident.

name: The Cat / Enchanted Princess
description: A sharp-tongued, resourceful cat who delivers game to the king, tricks a troll, and is revealed as a princess under enchantment.
visualPrompt: A sleek gray cat with bright intelligent eyes and a commanding stance; later envisioned as a luminous fairy-tale princess with refined features and rich, elegant attire, carrying an air of relieved freedom and clever authority.

name: The King
description: A proud ruler delighted by lavish gifts, increasingly irritated by Herreper’s boasts, and finally forced to admit he has been outshone.
visualPrompt: A middle-aged king with a heavy mantle and ornate crown, stern eyebrows and a jealous, skeptical expression; surrounded by courtly richness but visibly unsettled when faced with greater splendor.

name: The Troll
description: The monstrous owner of the glittering castle, undone when the cat lures him into turning toward the rising sun.
visualPrompt: A large, hulking troll with rough stone-like skin and wild features, looming at a grand gate with rage in his posture; vulnerable when caught by sunlight, suggesting a brittle, cracking end.
